# f5xc_policy_based_routing (Data Source)

Policy based routing is used to control how different classes of traffic is forwarded and QOS is<br>applied over WAN interfaces in SDWAN scenarios.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Policy Based Routing - Full

data "f5xc_policy_based_routing" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_policy_based_routing.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_policy_based_routing.example.namespace
}
```
